{{Quote|Our most popular salad, featuring crisp Revwien lettuce garnished with topatoes, space-carrots, Qiraadishes, Mandalorian oranges, Sriluurian raisins and Wol Cabasshews. Served with Luptoomian dressing.|Dex's Diner menu, on its interstellar garden salad|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Interstellar garden salad''' was a type of [[Salad/Legends|salad]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the most popular of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|salads]] available on the menu and consisted of crisp [[Revwien lettuce]] garnished with [[Topato/Legends|topatoes]], [[Carrot/Legends|space carrot]], [[Qiraadish]]es, [[Mandalorian orange]]s, [[Sriluurian raisin]]s and [[Wol Cabasshew]]s and served with [[Luptoomian dressing]]. The Diner [[Laser/Legends|laser]]&ndash;cut the [[Lettuce/Legends|lettuce]] and used toppings grown in locally [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[VegSatellite]]s. Dex's Diner sold the salad for 5.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] or 6.7 credits to include grilled [[Gornt/Legends|gornt]],<ref name="Menu" />  a domesticated [[Species/Legends|creature]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hethar]].<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Interstellar garden salad were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
